chapters.title: A bounded PyTorch investigation and framework comparison
findings: The published holdout needed a clearer distinction from a blind assessment.
Experiment selection and extrapolation needed a concrete decision trace.
Malformed words obscured the evidence boundary.

chapters.title: Tensors, devices, dtypes, strides and views
findings: The decision section was empty.
Storage offsets, contiguity and ownership needed separate reasoning.
Broadcast pairing needed a complete numerical counterexample.

chapters.title: Linear modules, parameters and matrix contracts
findings: The decision section was empty.
Forward layout and parameter count needed a shape ledger.
Registration, differentiation and optimizer membership needed clearer separation.

chapters.title: Loss functions, reductions and gradient scale
findings: The decision section was empty.
Mean reduction needed a batch-by-output derivation and masked-gradient trace.
Objective weighting and metric preference needed concrete comparisons.

chapters.title: Derivatives, requires_grad and finite-difference checks
findings: The decision section was empty.
Finite differences needed a truncation/cancellation derivation and a distinction from learning-rate steps.
The numerical helper did not reject a nonfinite point when a constant function hid it.

chapters.title: Autograd graphs, the chain rule and in-place hazards
findings: The decision section was empty.
The chain factors needed an exact forward/backward table.
In-place version checking and saved-graph lifetime needed a concrete failure sequence.

chapters.title: Leaf tensors, detach, no_grad and gradient accumulation
findings: The decision section was empty.
Graph history, gradient buffers, storage ownership and module mode needed a separate-state comparison.
None-versus-zero gradients needed an optimizer-aware interpretation.

chapters.title: One optimizer step you can audit
findings: The decision section was empty.
The one-step oracle needed a full objective and stability derivation.
The broadcast counterexample needed to show a changed optimum,not only a different first gradient.

chapters.title: Batches, zero_grad and repeated updates
findings: The decision section was empty.
Batch/update counts needed an exact parameter-state trace.
Metric weighting needed separation from evaluation at the final model state.

chapters.title: Datasets, held-out families and leakage controls
findings: The decision section was empty.
Subset delegation and split identity needed a concrete index/shape trace.
The held-out perturbation needed exact fitted-statistic arithmetic and claim limits.

chapters.title: nn.Module, registered parameters and explicit training loops
findings: The decision section was empty.
Module state categories needed a concrete ownership and persistence table.
Optimizer object membership and dtype conversion needed an operational ordering explanation.

chapters.title: Capstone: an auditable tiny PyTorch regressor
findings: The capstone decision section was empty.
The special basis-vector fixture allowed an independent closed-form100-step oracle that was missing.
The final-model metric needed distinction from the last pre-update loss in the curve.

chapters.title: Binary logits, BCEWithLogitsLoss and thresholds
findings: The decision section was empty.
Stable binary loss needed its algebra and gradient,not only API naming.
Threshold cost assumptions,double-sigmoid gradients andcalibration limits needed concrete reasoning.

chapters.title: CrossEntropyLoss, multiclass and multilabel contracts
findings: The decision section was empty.
Class-axis and target contracts needed a spatial/batched shape table.
Cross-entropy gradients,soft targets andweighted denominators needed clearer boundaries.

chapters.title: Dataset, DataLoader, collation and reproducible sampling
findings: The decision section was empty.
Sampler state,collation masks and tail populations needed distinct contracts.
The collator silently truncated floating token IDs into a Long tensor.

chapters.title: Initialization, nonlinearities and gradient diagnostics
findings: The decision section was empty.
XOR needed an affine impossibility proof and a full hidden-feature trace.
The symmetric XOR matrix could not detect the claimed transpose mistake.
Initialization symmetry needed conditions on downstream gradients and activation regions.

chapters.title: Dropout, regularization, train and eval modes
findings: The decision section was empty.
Dropout expectation was stated without its variance or backward trace.
Penalty coefficients, loss reduction and adaptive weight decay needed an explicit comparison.

chapters.title: BatchNorm, LayerNorm and stateful normalization
findings: The decision section was empty.
Axis retention versus reduction needed a complete shape ledger.
Momentum parity needed a non-half coefficient and distinct variance estimators.
Freezing affine gradients was not distinguished from freezing running statistics.

chapters.title: Convolutions, channel layouts and shared computation
findings: Output-size, dilation and parameter-sharing rules lacked a symbolic shape derivation.
The forward patch example did not explain how shared kernel and input gradients accumulate.
Semantic layout conversion, memory format and translation equivariance needed separate contracts.

chapters.title: Pooling, local augmentation and label invariants
findings: Pooling information loss needed a backward-sensitivity trace and boundary counterexamples.
A flip round trip was not distinguished fully from a valid target transformation.
Pooling defaults and ownership of deterministic evaluation outputs needed explicit decisions.

chapters.title: Embeddings, padded sequences and recurrent models
findings: Embedding lookup gradients and padding semantics needed an exact row-by-row trace.
Packed recurrent output, final-state axes and the detached worked-example boundary needed explanation.
Zero padding, mask propagation and valid-token versus per-sequence objectives were conflated by insufficient detail.

chapters.title: Attention, transformer masks and information boundaries
findings: Query/key/value axes and the softmax Jacobian needed a concrete forward/backward trace.
Mask polarity differences needed a parameter-level table and a float-mask counterexample.
Prefix agreement was overinterpreted as a complete arithmetic or model-causality check.

chapters.title: Debugging custom loops, accumulation and clipping
findings: The scalar update sequence needed exact before/loss/gradient/after states.
Accumulation weighting and clipping order were named without an unequal-microbatch counterexample.
Missing gradients,nonfinite gradients and optimizer displacement needed different diagnostic meanings.

chapters.title: Capstone: a small classifier with honest evaluation
findings: The classifier capstone needed an independently derived first update and preprocessing denominator comparison.
Visible synthetic labels and two test rows were insufficiently separated from population reliability.
Confusion accounting,threshold ties and subgroup denominators needed a complete decision trace.

chapters.title: Contrastive embeddings and negative sampling
findings: Contrastive temperature needed an exact loss/gradient derivation rather than a sharpness label.
The projection-gradient check needed its actual trainable branch and expected matrix explained.
False negatives,zero norms and changing candidate populations needed distinct failure contracts.

chapters.title: Custom modules, residual paths, buffers and autograd checks
findings: Residual forward identity needed a nonzero branch-gradient derivation.
Parameter objects,buffers,constructor metadata and optimizer identity needed distinct state roles.
Custom backward needed a vector-Jacobian-product explanation and clearer gradcheck limits.

chapters.title: Transfer learning, frozen layers and optimizer membership
findings: Freeze semantics needed a four-part state/mode/gradient/optimizer contract.
The head update and newly available base-gradient path lacked an exact local derivation.
Unfreezing needed explicit optimizer-state choices rather than implying recreation is mandatory.

chapters.title: Restartable training, optimizer state and RNG evidence
findings: Restart parity needed a state-dependency ledger and a precise RNG draw timeline.
The fixed data-position marker was not clearly separated from restoring a real loader or sampler.
Snapshot aliasing,optimizer reconstruction and checkpoint publication limits needed explanation.

chapters.title: Stable objectives, precision and mixed-precision boundaries
findings: Stable softmax/cross-entropy needed an exact shifted-logit and gradient derivation.
Range,precision and cancellation were not distinguished by concrete dtype comparisons.
Autocast,gradient scaling and clipping order needed separate hardware-qualified boundaries.

chapters.title: Distributed gradients and accumulation semantics on CPU
findings: Unequal-shard weighting needed a direct connection to backend averaging conventions.
The full-batch and sequential-microbatch trajectories needed exact distinct endpoints.
Empty shards,regularization and batch-dependent forward behavior needed explicit assumptions.

chapters.title: Profiling, torch.compile and honest performance measurement
findings: Graph capture,backend execution and optimizing compilation needed a phase-by-phase distinction.
The graph counter and timing interval needed precise observable meanings.
Profiler totals,signature diversity and setup amortization needed concrete interpretation.

chapters.title: state_dict, torch.export and inference parity
findings: State reconstruction and exported-program constraints needed a direct interface comparison.
Static batch specialization and declared dynamic bounds needed precise tested-versus-declared scope.
Feature semantics,artifact ownership and inference versus training continuation needed distinct acceptance gates.

chapters.title: Inference mode, model contracts and bounded batching
findings: Inference mode,eval and an owned normal output tensor needed a precise lifetime/gradient explanation.
Per-record batching parity needed its stateless-model assumptions and singleton-axis trace.
Input finiteness,batch bounds and output-value guarantees needed clearer scope.

chapters.title: Robustness, privacy and evidence beyond a score
findings: Duplicate weighting and subgroup uncertainty needed exact denominator counterexamples.
Perturbation outcomes needed a stated target policy rather than an unchanged-prediction slogan.
Privacy mechanisms,severity gates and finite empirical evidence needed separate meanings.

chapters.title: Paired model comparisons and uncertainty
findings: The paired loss comparison needed its full per-ID table and covariance explanation.
The three-point bootstrap needed an exact empirical distribution and a distinction from new evidence.
Resampling units,training variability and selection history needed separate uncertainty contracts.

chapters.title: Capstone: release a small reproducible PyTorch model
findings: The release capstone needed an analytic training/holdout oracle and explicit artifact boundaries.
Hash integrity,metadata validation and publisher trust needed separate meanings.
Local acceptance,negative-gate success,rollback identity and production readiness needed precise scope.
